|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current full-face version; the current full-face version is [[Major Taslin Brance (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-majortaslinbrance-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates identify full-face repository revisions and the printed edition of the slip; first publication of the partial is unknown. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-majortaslinbrance022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/majortaslinbrance.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/majortaslinbrance.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Major Olander Brit”. Text: “If opponent just looked at cards in their deck or pile, after replacing, you may peek at the top card of that deck or pile. At the start of your control phase, if the top card of your Lost Pile is a Resistance character or [Resistance] starship, opponent loses 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Major Taslin Brance (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-majortaslinbrancea57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/majortaslinbrance.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/majortaslinbrance.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Major Olander Brit” → “Major Olander Brit” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Major Olander Brit”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “If opponent just looked at cards in their deck or pile, after replacing, you may peek at the top card of that deck or pile. At the start of your control phase, if the top card of your Lost Pile is a Resistance character or [Resistance] starship, opponent loses 1 Force.”

* '''Partial layout''' ([[Major Taslin Brance (Errata 2)]]): the September 2023 sheet edition prints a art-cutout layout with the same current text.
